mechanics.claim: Camille sweeps in a cone over a fixed animation, during which she is ghosted and cannot basic attack, before the damage lands afterwards.
mechanics.quote: sweeps her leg in a cone in the target direction over {{fd|1.1}} seconds, during which she is {{tip|ghosted}} and unable to declare basic attacks. Afterwards, she deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within.

mechanics.claim: The outer-cone additional damage is a separate damage instance from the base cone damage, so it can trigger a mitigation effect like Bone Plating a second time, but both hits still belong to the same cast instance so they do not grant extra Conqueror/Electrocute stacks.
mechanics.quote: Because the increased damage in the outer range of the cone is dealt as an '''additional''' instance of damage (as opposed to '''bonus''' damage to the original instance), it will trigger effects twice such as being reduced by {{ri|Bone Plating}} an extra time.

mechanics.claim: Camille heals for 100% of the outer-cone additional damage, post-mitigation, but only against enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' is {{tip|healing|healed}} for 100% of this '''additional''' damage {{tt|post-mitigation|After modifiers such as resistances}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} in the outer half.

mechanics.claim: Other abilities can be cast during Tactical Sweep's animation without cancelling it, so it does not block other actions.
mechanics.quote: Other abilities can be cast during the animation without cancelling it.
